==Notes==
* This skill is triggered by any incoming damage (not conditions or life steal), ending the stance, causing AoE blind, and halving the first packet of damage received.

== Trivia ==
* This skill was renamed from "Smoke Powder" during the development phase of [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]].
* The figure in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Assassin Elite Imperial armor|Elite Imperial armor]].
* The figure in the skill icon is shown being under the blind condition animation.
